PR title: fix(drain): token-bind the reminder's agent-ack pin — stale pane residue must not read as an answer

PR description:
## Summary

A reused pane can carry a prior incarnation's `GC_DRAIN_ACK_SOURCE=agent` in its tmux environment. The drain reminder's ack pin honored that residue unbound — silently skipping every reminder ("already acked", a marker-less exit) while token-bound readers elsewhere refused the same residue as unprovable. Two readers, one residue, opposite verdicts: production wedges of 3–14 hours with zero journal evidence (forensically settled from a 14h specimen with 130+ swallowed cycles; a live pre-residue pane confirmed the mechanism).

The fix ships the requester stamp and its reader as one unit (this repo lacked `GC_DRAIN_ACK_REQUESTER_INSTANCE_TOKEN` entirely — a pin alone would be inert or over-remind): `setDrainAck` stamps the acker's incarnation token; the reminder's skip is honored only for a proven-current ack; proven-stale or absent proceeds with the reminder; unprovable holds with a breadcrumb. Both clear paths retire the stamp (no permanent pane residue). Three-verdict semantics are deliberate: informational arms proceed on unprovable, destructive arms refuse — only proven-stale can ever authorize anything.

## Review

Forensic arbitration (three competing mechanisms falsified/refined by experiment — including a red-run where deleting the suspected gate entirely left the repro red) → implementation → adversarial review (1 major + 2 minors, all fixed: the residue scrub is ack-keys-only so the drain request's supersession binding survives, pinned by the reviewer's own probe; honest reason strings; clear-list parity). Mutation probes bite on every pin.

Refs: ga-o6uw0
